slides.texte_overlay:
Things a man should
never stop doing
Training his body. At 25, at 45, at 70. Strength and mobility are what keep you independent, energetic and confident for your whole life.
Making new friends. Many men stop after school and slowly become lonely. Keep meeting people through sport, work, hobbies and neighbours.
Dating his partner. Dinners, surprises, little gestures. Relationships stay alive when you keep putting in the effort you did at the start.
Learning new skills. A language, an instrument, a trade. Being a beginner again keeps your mind young and your life interesting.
Before: I stopped learning after university. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I feel curious again every single day.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I stopped learning after university. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I feel curious again every single day.

slides.texte_overlay: Calling his parents. The calls feel routine until one day they stop. Ten minutes a week is something you'll never regret.
Having fun. Playing football with friends, dancing at weddings, laughing at silly things. Growing up doesn't mean becoming serious all the time.
